definition: Open-Source AI Collectives: collectives training shared open AI models.

title: Real Research Today: Open-Source AI Collectives
definition: Today's documented research behind Open-Source AI Collectives.
description:
The road to Open-Source AI Collectives is already being paved. Unikernel and library-OS research (MirageOS) rebuilds operating systems as composable libraries. Projectional editing (JetBrains MPS) lets languages reshape the editor itself.

WebAssembly brings sandboxed near-native code to every browser and edge device. Together these programs form the training pools foundation that Open-Source AI Collectives will build on — the collective logistics results, the compute sharing methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as collective logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Open-Source AI Collectives Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Open-Source AI Collectives: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Open-Source AI Collectives — collectives training shared open AI models.

Phase 1 — Prove (training pools): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (collective logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (compute sharing): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (model governance): collective hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and research-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
